fix.item: ⁠Works with the JCE editor: Opus took it for TinyMCE, the Joomla editor, and tried to drop its cards into it. That confusion could stop JCE from starting.
⁠Under JCE the “Opus: place a block” button works; block cards stay a TinyMCE feature.

addition.item: ⁠Opus becomes a package: the module and two plugins, installed and enabled on their own. Your modules and their settings stay as they are.
⁠New: place an Opus block inside an article. The editor button “Opus: place a block” opens a panel: Layout, Element, Reuse.
⁠In the article each block becomes a card: drag it, add a block above or below, edit it in a large window, preview it, remove it.
⁠The module list says which article each block is placed in.
⁠Map: service area by travel time or by kilometres. Cards: number of columns of your choice (automatic, 2, 3 or 4).
⁠Agenda: more readable dates, yearly events, looser date entry, declared to search engines.
⁠Texts and tables: a small bar with Bold, Italic, Link, List; paragraphs kept; simple formatting inside cells.

note.item: ⁠Requires Joomla 6.2 or newer. A site still on Joomla 6.1 keeps its current version and is offered nothing that could break it.
